environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy includes a condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' at the account level via an SCP (Service Control Policy) on the OU. The SCP denies lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl unless aws:PrincipalArn matches roles in the internal-services path. Additionally, the S3 bucket has a bucket policy with a Deny statement for s3:PutObject where the object key matches 'uploads/*' and the content-type header is NOT in an allowlist (image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf) using StringNotEquals on s3:content-type-header. The Lambda execution role's permission boundary restricts s3:PutObject to keys matching 'uploads/*.{png,jpg,pdf}' pattern via a StringLike condition. Note: the Function URL itself shows AuthType=AWS_IAM in console but the actual enforcement depends on the resource-based policy evaluation chain and the SCP precedence rules.

config.scp_policy: Deny lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl unless aws:PrincipalArn like arn:aws:iam::*:role/internal-services/*
config.s3_bucket_policy_deny_content_type: Deny s3:PutObject unless s3:content-type in [image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf]
config.permission_boundary: Allow s3:PutObject only for keys matching uploads/*.png, uploads/*.jpg, uploads/*.pdf
config.resource_policy: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl requires sigv4 with valid IAM credentials
